question: When does a person become fit for attaining a share in Rudra?
premises: After these rites a person becomes twice-born.
That twice-born person becomes fit for attaining a share in Rudra.
The guru should apply these consecrations in the sequence of the breath.
inference: Consecration performed in the proper breath sequence makes the twice-born fit to attain a share in Rudra.
uncertainties: The technical details of the breath sequence are not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Then the person becomes twice-born and fit to attain a share in Rudra; the guru should apply these consecrations in the very sequence of the breath.
